tools.label: Coverage set from one still
tools.blurb: Upload one photo and get four new camera angles of the same scene: a wide, a close-up, a three-quarter and a low angle, or a full turnaround.

example.note: The source is an invented woman made with Z-Image Turbo for this example; then the coverage set, seed 4101, run once through this tool. The three-quarter turn is gentle; the wide and the close-up moved the most.

tools.label: Relight a photo
tools.blurb: Pick a light and the photo is relit: the people, the clothes and the framing stay, only the light changes.

text.direction: Your own light, in plain words (optional, replaces the pick)

items.label: Neon night, on the invented woman from the coverage set (seed 4106, 19.2 s)

example.note: The source is an invented man made with Z-Image Turbo for this example, in flat studio light; then golden hour, seed 4102, run once through this tool. The light, the shadows and the wall changed as asked; the face changed a little too, so check a likeness before you use it.

tools.label: One-tap photo effects
tools.blurb: Inflate the subject like a balloon, or turn it to marble or gold. Ask for a clip and LTX-2.5 moves from your photo to the effect, with sound.

text.subject: What to change, in a few words (default: the person)

items.label: Marble statue, on the invented woman from the coverage set (seed 4105, 21.6 s)

example.note: The source is an invented man made with Z-Image Turbo for this example; then inflate, seed 4103, our own render. The still took 26.8 s at 28.7 GB on its own; the numbers shown are the still + clip run, where the graph unloads Qwen before LTX loads (66 GB before that change). The clip starts on the photo and swells into the edit with no cross-fade: a glossy balloon rises from the lap and settles into the puffed jacket. The face drifts a little toward the edited still by the end. No person has listened to its sound.
